Name.help_text: Name to use in the output binary's directory. Maximum length is 4 characters.

Length.help_text: Length of output binary, extra space will be filled with 0xFF's. If length is smaller than required, an error will be reported. If set to 0, the length will be computed as needed by the tool.

Usage.help_text: Indicates the type of data contained in this binary. This value is used during signature verification to validate the public key.

PartitionFlags.help_text: Refers to flags relevant to manifest for a specific partition.

VersionMajor.label: Version Major
VersionMajor.help_text: Used to manually set the Major Version field in the manifest

VersionMinor.label: Version Minor
VersionMinor.help_text: Used to manually set the Minor Version field in the manifest

VersionHotfix.label: Version Hotfix
VersionHotfix.help_text: Used to manually set the Hotfix Version field in the manifest

VersionBuild.label: Version Build
VersionBuild.help_text: Used to manually set the Build Version field in the manifest

Enabled.help_text: If enabled, the version details will be extracted from the InputFile binary at the offsets specified. If disabled, the version must be specified manually.

InputFile.help_text: Binary file from which to extract the version details.

VersionMajorByte0Offset.help_text: Offset of Major Version number's LSB in InputFile.

VersionMajorByte1Offset.help_text: Offset of Major Version number's MSB in InputFile.

VersionMinorByte0Offset.help_text: Offset of Minor Version number's LSB in InputFile.

VersionMinorByte1Offset.help_text: Offset of Minor Version number's MSB in InputFile.

VersionHotfixByte0Offset.help_text: Offset of Hotfix Version number's LSB in InputFile.

VersionHotfixByte1Offset.help_text: Offset of Hotfix Version number's MSB in InputFile.

VersionBuildByte0Offset.help_text: Offset of Build Version number's LSB in InputFile.

VersionBuildByte1Offset.help_text: Offset of Build Version number's MSB in InputFile.

IpSpecificData0.help_text: IP specific data in manifest header (bytes 0-3)

IpSpecificData1.help_text: IP specific data in manifest header (bytes 4-7)

IpSpecificData2.help_text: IP specific data in manifest header (bytes 8-11)

IpSpecificData3.help_text: IP specific data in manifest header (bytes 12-15)

IpSpecificData4.help_text: IP specific data in manifest header (bytes 16-19)

IpSpecificData5.help_text: IP specific data in manifest header (bytes 20-23)

InputFile.help_text: Path to binary file to load for this module's data.

CompressionType.help_text: Select compression type for this module.

ipl_metadata_enabled.help_text: Set to true in order to enable IP's specific ip loading metadata for this module
